svg.title: The isolated evaluation boundary
svg.desc: Separate the container from external network access with a continuous barrier. Show no peer-channel socket or direct connection; the next panel must introduce a distinct permitted affordance. Use the independent evaluation container boundary geometry to identify this setting; keep the existing labels, qualifications and foreground relationships. Visual distinction: A solid tiled network wall with disconnected cable ends. Indicates unavailable reach, not a decision awaiting human approval.
